source: 痛っつつ・・・
translation: Ouch, that hurts...

source: なにすんのよ・・・
translation: What was that for...?

source: あ・・・ごめん・・・
translation: Ah... I'm sorry...

source: はっ！？
translation: Huh!?

source:
いやーーっ！チカン！
変態ーーっ！！
translation:
Nooo! Pervert!
Stay away from me!!

source: ぎゅう・・・
translation: Ugh...

source: 何だ、まだ子供じゃない
translation: What? He's just a kid.

source: 悪いことしたかな・・・？
translation: Did I do something bad...?

source: この子が使うのかな・・・？
translation: Does he use this...?

source:
ごめんねマスター、初対面で、
いきなり迷惑かけちゃって
translation:
Sorry, barkeep, for causing
a fuss the moment we met.

source:
何の、かわいい女の子の頼みと
あっちゃ断れないさ
translation:
Don't mention it. I can't
turn down a cute girl's request.

source:
それじゃ、ちょっとの間だけお
願いね
translation:
Then please look after him
for just a little while.

source: ああ、いい仕事が見つかるといいな
translation:
Sure thing. Hope you find
a good job out there.

source: もう仕事は決めてるの
translation: I've already decided on my job!

source: そうか。冒険者だったな
translation: Ah, right. An adventurer, was it?

source:
まずは、冒険者ギルドへ行って
登録しなきゃ
translation:
First, I've got to register
at the Adventurer's Guild.

source:
行きたいところを選ぶと、街の
中を移動することができるの。
translation:
Pick a destination to move
around the town.

source:
左右またはＬＲで選んでボタン
で決定よ
translation:
Use Left/Right or L/R to select,
then press the button to confirm.

source: ん？もう職は決まったのかい？
translation: Hmm? Already decided on a job?

source: 帰んな
translation: Go home, kid.

source: ご挨拶ね
translation: Well, that's not very polite.

source:
当たり前だな、小娘一人で何が出
来るって言うんだ？あ？
translation:
Naturally. What could a little
girl like you do all alone, huh?

source:
失礼ね！これでも８年のキャリ
アがあるのよ？
translation:
How rude! For your information,
I've got eight years of experience!

source:
だったらわかるだろう？いくら
あんたが裸だったとしても、
所詮魔法使い一人じゃあ、
translation:
Then you should know. A mage
all on their own can't do squat!

source:
いざ実戦ってことになっても役に
立たねェってことか
translation:
When a real fight starts,
you're utterly helpless!

source: う・・・そりゃあ・・・
translation: Ugh... well, that's...

source:
魔法使いは、盾となって戦う戦
士がいて初めてその力を発揮で
きるんだ。
translation:
A mage needs a warrior to act
as a shield before they can
cast any real magic!

source:
あんた一人じゃ、のんびり呪文
を唱えている間に剣でばっさり
だ
translation:
All by yourself, someone would
slice you down before you even
finished chanting!

source: うう～～～
translation: Urrgh...

source: 悪いこと言わねェから帰んな？
translation: Take my advice and run along home.

source:
そうそう、そのカフェの、
ウェイトレスのバイトなら紹介
してやっからよ
translation:
If you want, I could hook you up
with a waitress gig at that café.

source:
余計なお世話よっ！！
ふんっ！！
translation:
Mind your own business!!
Hmph!!

source: おー怖えぇ
translation: Ooh, so scary!

source:
何よ何よ何よっ！子供だと思っ
てバカにしてぇっ！
translation:
What was that for?! Just because
I'm young, you look down on me!

source: あーもう！ちょームカツク！
translation: Argh! I'm so mad!

source:
ファーック！！ミーノの店で食
い逃げとか、グッドな度胸デー
ス！
translation:
Good grief! Skipping out on
the bill at Mino's?! You've got
some serious nerve!!

source:
だからっ！財布を忘れただけだ
と言っただろう！？
translation:
I told you! I just forgot my
wallet at home, alright?!

source: あ、あの人は・・・？
translation: Wait, isn't that...?

source:
そんなウソ、
ミーノに通じません！
translation:
Such flimsy lies won't work
on Mino!

source:
最初っから、マネーサッキング
ジョンに言っておけばよかったんだ！
translation:
I should have known you were
a deadbeat from the start!

source:
馬鹿にするな。お前さんの店を
まるごと全部買い占めるくらい
の金は持ってる
translation:
Don't mock me. I've got enough
gold to buy out your whole shop!

source:
Ｏｈ！グレイト！そんなにリッ
チでしたら、
translation:
Oh, how marvelous! If you're so
filthy rich,

source:
どこのどちら様で、どんなワー
クなさっているのか言ってみな
サーイ！
translation:
then please tell me who you are
and what profession you hold!

source:
う、いや・・・ほら、いい男っ
てのは、素性や仕事は秘密にす
るもんだろ？
translation:
Er, well... real gentlemen always
keep their identity and job
a charming mystery, don't they?

source:
あなた、言ってること、さっぱ
りトンチンカン！
translation:
You are talking absolute
nonsense!

source:
こーなったら、切り刻んで、
スープの具にするデース！
translation:
That's it! I'm chopping you up
to stew in my soup!!

source: まずいっ、助けなきゃ！
translation: Uh-oh, I've got to help him!

source:
ああ・・・これほど言っても信じ
てもらえないなんて・・・
translation:
Alas... to think no one believes
my honest words...

source:
それとも我が身の不徳ゆえか、
ならば、いっそのこと消えてし
まうか
translation:
Is it my own shortcomings? If so,
perhaps I should simply fade away...

source:
消えよう。花びらの露のように
夜明けの光と共に消えよう・・・
translation:
Fade like morning dew upon petals,
vanishing with the dawn light...

source: オー、マイガッ！？
translation: Oh, good heavens!?

source: ふう・・・ひどい目にあった
translation: Phew... that was an awful mess.

source: おっじさんっ
translation: Mis-ter T.T.!

source:
あとで誰かに頼んで金を持って
行かせるか・・・
translation:
I'll have someone bring the money
over later...

source: おっじさんっ
translation: Mis-ter T.T.!

source: おっじさんっ
translation: Mis-ter T.T.!

source:
いいか？お嬢ちゃん、俺はまだ
おじさんと呼ばれるような年に
なった覚えはないんだ。
translation:
Listen here, young lady. I am far
too young to be called 'Mister'!

source:
おにーさんと呼べ、おにーさん
と
translation:
Call me 'Handsome', or at least
'Big Brother'!

source:
だって、
Ｔ．Ｔ．おじさんでしょ？
translation:
But you ARE Mister T.T.,
aren't you?

source:
だぁぁぁぁ、
俺はおじさんじゃ・・・
translation: Nooo! I am NOT an old...

source: カリン・・・カリンちゃんか？
translation: Karin...? Is that little Karin?!

source: やっぱりＴ．Ｔ．おじさんだ
translation: I knew it was you, Mister T.T.!

source:
いやー、こんなに大きくなっ
てるなんて・・・見違えたな
translation:
Wow, look how big you've grown!
I barely recognized you!

source: えへへ
translation: Ehehe!

source:
こんな所立ち話もなんだな、
そっちにカフェがあるから、そ
こで話そう
translation:
No sense standing around here.
There's a café right over there,
let's chat inside.

source:
しかし本当に驚いたよ。久しぶ
りに会ったら、こんなに美人に
なっているとはね
translation:
I'm genuinely amazed. Seeing you
after all this time, and you've
grown into such a lovely lady!

source:
えへへ、ありがとう。Ｔ．Ｔ．お
じさんは変わらないね。相変
わらず芸術の腕も冴えてるし
translation:
Hehe, thanks! You haven't changed
at all, Mister T.T. Still as flashy
and dramatic as ever!

source:
カリンちゃん、ハンサムは年を
取らないものなんだよ
translation:
My dear Karin, a handsome man
never truly ages.

source:
じゃあ、あと１０年たったら、
どうなるの？
translation:
So what happens ten years
from now?

source:
ナイスガイからナイスミドルに
変身するのさ。今はまだナイス
ガイだ。
translation:
I simply transition from a fine
youth to a dashing gentleman!
For now, I'm still a fine youth.

source:
だから、おじさんと呼ぶのはや
めてくれ
translation:
So please, stop calling me
'Mister' or 'Uncle'!

source: そ、でもなの？
translation: I-Is that so?

source: いらっしゃいませ
translation: Welcome, may I take your order?

source:
あ、ボク、
ロイヤルミルクティー
translation: Ah, royal milk tea for me, please!

source: ジャイアントいちごパフェ
translation: A giant strawberry parfait for me.

source:
あ、ここは俺がおごるから、
もっと色々頼んでもいいぞ
translation:
Don't be shy, it's on me.
Order whatever you like!

source: 財布忘れたんじゃなかったの？
translation: Didn't you forget your wallet?

source: ・・・ボクが払っておくね
translation: ...I'll pay for it.

source: すまん・・・
translation: I'm sorry...

source:
そうか・・・ブライアン師さん
も通ったのか
translation:
I see... Even Master Brian
passed through here.

source:
うん、それで、島を出よう
と思って、前から大陸にあこが
れてたから
translation:
Yeah. So I decided to leave the
island. I've always dreamed of
visiting the continent!

source:
ここはいい街だ。８年間暮らし
ている俺が保証するよ
translation:
It's a wonderful city. I've lived
here eight years, I can vouch for it!

source: そうみたいね
translation: It sure seems that way.

source:
その割には、表情が暗いじゃな
いか
translation:
Though you look rather gloomy
for someone living their dream.

source: うん・・・実は・・・
translation: Well... truth is...

source:
なるほどな。確かに、ギルドの
言い分ももっともだ
translation:
I see. The Guild has a valid
point, to be fair.

source: でも、それにしたって・・・
translation:
Still, they didn't have to be
so mean about it...

source:
カリンちゃんの腕は俺も良く
知ってるよ。だが問題となれば
やはり戦士が一人は必要だ。
translation:
I know how skilled you are, Karin.
But out in the field, having a
warrior by your side is vital.

source:
誰か、仲間になってくれそうな
心当たりはないのかい？
translation:
Do you know anyone who might
be willing to team up with you?

source:
ごめん、急用が出来たからもう
行くね
translation:
Sorry, something just came up!
I've got to run!

source: ああ、しっかりおやり
translation: Sure, go get 'em!

source: ありがとう！Ｔ．Ｔ．おじさん
translation: Thanks, Mister T.T.!

source: さて、俺も準備しておくか
translation: Well, time for me to get moving too.

source: お客様、お勘定をお願いします
translation: Excuse me, sir. Your bill, please.

source: 皿洗いじゃだめかい？
translation: Could I perhaps wash dishes instead?

source: お帰り、彼氏、起きてるよ
translation:
Welcome back. Your boyfriend
is finally awake.

source: そーなんじゃないって！
translation: He is NOT my boyfriend!!

source: あ・・・お帰り
translation: Ah... welcome back.

source:
大丈夫？ごめんね、ちょっと無
茶し過ぎちゃった
translation:
Are you alright? Sorry, I overdid
it a little earlier.

source: うん・・・僕こそごめん
translation: Yeah... I should apologize too.

source:
ね、名前は何て言うの？ボクは
カリン。エントリヒで島から
来たの
translation:
Hey, what's your name? I'm Karin!
I came from Entrich Island.

source: 僕は・・・アル
translation: My name is... Al.

source:
アルかぁ、よろしくね。で、
どこから来たの？
translation:
Al, huh? Nice to meet you! So,
where did you come from?

source: わからない
translation: I don't know.

source: え？
translation: Huh?

source:
あんまり昔の事、憶えてないん
だ。気がついたら、一人で旅を
してた・・・
translation:
I can't remember my past.
When I came to, I was traveling
all on my own...

source:
ずっと昔から、そうしていたよ
うな気もしたし、あの港で君を
見つけたんだ
translation:
It felt like I'd been doing it
forever. Then I saw you at the harbor.

source: どうしてボクを？
translation: Why me?

source:
どこかで会ったような気がした。
何だか、とっても懐かしいよう
な。
translation:
It felt like we'd met before.
Like a distant, nostalgic memory.

source:
だから、僕の事を何か知ってる
んじゃないかと思って
translation:
I thought you might know
something about who I am.

source:
そうだったんだ・・・でも、ボ
クの方はキミに会うのは初めて
だよ
translation:
I see... But this is the first
time I've ever seen you.

source: そうか・・・そうだよね
translation: Right... of course it is.

source: ごめんね、力になれなくて
translation: Sorry I couldn't help.

source: あ、あのさ
translation: U-Um, by the way...

source: 何ですか？
translation: Yes? What is it?

source: この剣、キミの？
translation: Is this sword yours?

source: え？・・・ええ
translation: Huh? ...Yeah, it is.

source: じゃあ、キミ、剣士なんだ
translation: Then you're a swordsman!

source:
あんまりこういうのは好きじゃ
ないんだけど、旅をするには
そうも言ってられなくて
translation:
I don't really like fighting,
but you need it to survive on the road.

source:
ねえ、もしとりあえず行くとこ
ろがないんだったら、ボクと
パーティ組まない？
translation:
Say, if you don't have anywhere
to go, want to form a party with me?

source: 君と？
translation: With you?

source:
そっ、これでも、魔法使いなの
よ
translation: Yep! I happen to be a mage!

source: うん・・・いいよ
translation: Sure... sounds good.

source:
やったっ、これで、あいつを見返
してやれるわ
translation:
Yay! Now I can wipe that smug
grin off his face!

source: え？何の話？
translation: Huh? What are you talking about?

source:
いいからいいから、ね、もう起
きれる？
translation:
Never mind! Come on, can you
stand up yet?

source: うん・・・
translation: Yeah...

source:
じゃあ、早速悪いけど、
ちょっと付き合って。外で待っ
てるから
translation:
Sorry to rush you, but come along!
I'll wait outside!
Ah... wait!

source:
あの・・・
どこへ行くんですか？
translation: Um... where are we going?

source: いいからいいから
translation: Just come on!

source: おっ、来たな
translation: Oho, you're back.

source:
当然でしょ。さぁ、今度は立派
な剣士も一緒よ
translation:
Naturally! And look, I brought
a fine swordsman with me!

source: ・・・弱そうだな
translation: ...Looks pretty frail to me.

source: すみません・・・
translation: I'm sorry...

source:
素人じゃあるまいし、見かけで
判断する？キミも、同意しない
のっ！
translation:
What, are you an amateur? Don't
judge by looks! And Al, stop agreeing!

source: ご、ごめんなさい
translation: S-Sorry!

source:
とにかく、そんなフシ穴の目で
判断しないで！
translation:
Anyway, stop judging people with
your blind eyes!

source:
ほおお、よし、そこまで言うん
だったら、証明してもらおう
じゃねーか
translation:
Oho! If you're that confident,
how about proving it in action?

source: ど、どうするのよ？
translation: H-How do we do that?

source:
心配するな、ちょっとテストす
るだけだ。仕事を一つやるから
見事にやり遂げて見せろ。
translation:
Don't sweat it, just a little test.
I'll give you a job; finish it
cleanly and prove yourselves.

source: そうしたら認めてやるあ
translation: Do that, and you're in.

source:
いいの？いいの？で、何をすれば
いいの？
translation: Really?! What do we have to do?

source:
最近、街道付近でスライムが大
量発生しやがった。
translation:
Lately, slimes have been swarming
near the highway.

source:
冒険者にとっちゃあぜんぜん楽
勝のモンスターだが、面倒なこ
とにはそうもいかん。
translation:
Easy pickings for any adventurer,
but a real nuisance for travelers.

source:
そこでだ、ちょっと行って掃除
をしてきてもらいてぇ。受ける
か？
translation:
So go clear them out. You up
for the job?

source:
簡単すぎるような気もするけど
いいよ
translation: Sounds almost too easy, but sure!

source:
いくら何でも、ちょっとヒドす
ぎない！？バカにするのも程々
にしてよね
translation:
Wait, that's practically insult work!
Stop treating me like an amateur!

source:
どんな内容でも、俺たちにしか
出来ない以上、立派な仕事だ。
嫌なら、他の職を探すんだな
translation:
Any task only we can do is an honest
job! Don't like it? Go find another trade.

source: う・・・わ、わかったわよぉ
translation: Ugh... f-fine, I get it!

source:
危険も少ないし、最初の仕事に
はうってつけだろ？じゃあ早速
仕事に入ってくれ
translation:
Low danger, perfect first job.
Now get out there and do it!

source:
何だ？まだ仕事に行ってねぇの
か？
translation: What? Haven't left yet?

source: その・・・どこ行けばいーのか
translation: Um... where do we go?

source:
街から出りゃあいいんだ！さっ
さと行きやがれ！
translation:
Just head out of town!
Now get moving!

source: これを全部退治すればいいんだ
translation: Just wipe all of these out, right?

source: 楽勝ね
translation: Piece of cake!

source:
思った通り楽勝だったね。
でも、キミも結構やるじゃない
translation:
Easy, just as I thought!
Hey, you're pretty good with a blade!

source:
そうですか？ありがとうござい
ます
translation: You think so? Thank you.

source: じゃ、帰ろっか
translation: Alright, let's head back!

source: ハッ！？
translation: Huh!?

source: こんなところにドラゴンが！？
translation: A dragon in a place like this?!

source: カリン！下がって！
translation: Karin, get back!

source: アル！危ない！
translation: Al! Look out!

source: アル！
translation: Al!

source: カリン・・・逃げて・・・
translation: Karin... run...

source:
ダメ！キミを置いて、ボク一人
で逃げられないよ！
translation:
No! I'm not leaving you behind
to run away alone!

source: カリン！
translation: Karin!

source: アル、大丈夫？
translation: Al, are you okay?

source: う、うん・・・大丈夫だよ
translation: Y-Yeah... I'm alright.

source: あ、ありがとう。助けてくれて
translation: Th-Thank you for saving us.

source: 人違いだ
translation: You have the wrong person.

source: え？
translation: What?

source: 俺という男は・・・未練だな
translation: What a fool I am... clinging to the past.

source: 今の人・・・知り合い？
translation: That man just now... do you know him?

source: さあ・・・誰だろう？
translation: No... I wonder who he was?

source: なぁんですってぇ！？
translation: What did you say?!

source:
手配モンスターがいたなんて初
耳よ！？
translation:
A wanted bounty monster?! You never
mentioned that before!

source:
すまんすまん、ま、こちらの情
報も完璧なわけではないんだ、
勘弁してくれ
translation:
Sorry, sorry! Our intel isn't always
flawless, cut me some slack!

source:
とにかく、危険な目にあっただ
けの報酬は貰うわよ！
translation:
Anyway, you're paying us hazard pay
for putting our lives on the line!

source:
しかし、実際に倒したのは、そ
の名前も知らん男だったろう？
translation:
But the one who actually killed it
was that mystery man, right?

source: うっ・・・そりゃあ・・・
translation: Ugh... well, technically...

source:
んじゃ、そういうことだ。見か
けたら、報酬を払いに街のギ
ルドに寄ってくれと伝えてくれ
translation:
So that settles it. If you see him,
tell him to swing by for his reward.

source: 知らないわよっ！ふんっ！
translation: Hmph! Find him yourself!

source:
はっはっは、災難だったな。そ
りゃあ、明日正式に登録するか
ら、
translation:
Hahaha, tough break! Well, I'll
officially register you tomorrow,

source:
今日はもう金もらって
ゆっくり休みな
translation: so take your coin and get some rest.

source:
経験値は手動配分にすると、そ
れぞれの配分を変えることがで
きる。
translation:
With manual EXP distribution,
you can adjust how experience is shared.

source:
通常はメンバーが均等に成長す
るように振り分けるんだ
translation:
Normally, you want to divide it evenly
so everyone grows at a steady pace.

source:
それじゃ、また明日来ればいい
のね？
translation: So I just come back tomorrow, right?

source: そういう事だ
translation: That's the ticket.

source:
ありがとう、それじゃ、これから
よろしく
translation:
Thanks! I'm looking forward to
working with you, Al!

source: お、おう
translation: Y-Yeah, me too.

source:
ん、どうした？今日はもう帰っ
て休みな
translation:
Hmm? What is it? Go on home and
get some shut-eye.

source:
っておいっ！？何で俺の名前を
知ってるんだっ！？
translation:
Wait, hey! How on earth do you
know my name?!

source: キミも、同意しないのっ！
translation: Don't you agree with him, Al!

source:
よう、よく眠れたか？じゃあ、
早速だがこっちに来てくれ
translation:
Yo! Sleep well? Right then,
come over this way.

source: 何なの？
translation: What is it?

source:
まあ、面接試験みたいなもんかね。
普通はやらないんだが
translation:
Well, think of it as an interview.
We don't normally do this, but...

source:
昨日のじゃ、まだ足りないって
言うの？
translation: Was yesterday's test not enough?

source:
ありゃあ、あんたが俺を怒らす
からだ。本当は、あんたが来た
ら、
translation:
That was because you pissed me off.
Truth is, the moment you showed up,

source:
すぐギルドに登録してやるよう
に言われてたんだから
translation:
I was ordered to register you
right away.

source: どういう事よ？
translation: What's that supposed to mean?

source:
俺にもよくわからん。
とにかく、うちのボスが会いた
がっているから来てくれ
translation:
Beats me. Either way, our boss
wants to meet you, so come on.

source: わかったわ。案内して
translation: Fine. Lead the way.

source: よっしゃ。こっちへ来な
translation: Alright. Follow me.

source: Ｔ．Ｔ．おじさん！？
translation: Mister T.T.?!

source: よっ、また会ったね
translation: Hey there! We meet again.

source:
どうしてＴ．Ｔ．おじさんがこ
こに？
translation: Why are you here, Mister T.T.?

source: 当ててごらん
translation: Care to take a guess?

source:
わかった！Ｔ．Ｔ．おじさんも
職探しに来たのね？
translation:
I know! You're looking for
a job too, right?

source:
こっ、このアマ・・・さっきか
ら聞いてりゃ、ボスに向かって
おじさんおじさんと・・
translation:
Wh-Why you little...! Calling our
boss 'Mister' over and over again!

source:
それはボスに禁句なんだぞ！？
それを、おじさんおじさんと何
回も・・
translation:
That is strictly forbidden!
Yet you keep saying it!
...Hey. (glare)

source: はっ！し、失礼しました！
translation: Gah! M-My apologies, boss!

source:
まさか・・・Ｔ．Ｔ．おじさんが
ギルドマスター？
translation: Wait... YOU are the Guildmaster?!

source:
ほら、能ある鷹は爪を隠すって
言うだろ？このことは内緒だよ
translation:
A wise hawk hides his talons,
you know? Keep it a secret, okay?

source:
いいけど・・・どうして？昨日
なんか、食い逃げにされかけた
のに
translation:
Fine... but why? You were almost
arrested for dining and dashing yesterday!

source:
ヒーローは、ここだっ！という
時にしか、正体を現しちゃいけ
ないんだよ。
translation:
A true hero only reveals himself
at the absolute critical moment!

source: それが、セオリーというものさ
translation: That is the golden rule of style.

source: あ、そう・・・
translation: Uh, sure... whatever you say...

source:
ま、それは置いといて・・早速
活躍してくれたそうじゃないか
translation:
Anyway, putting that aside... I hear
you two already made quite a splash!

source: えへへ
translation: Ehehe!

source:
どうやらいゝパートナーも見つ
けたようだし、
translation: Looks like you found a fine partner too,

source:
正式にうちのメンバーとして登
録させてもらうよ
translation:
so I hereby officially register you
as members of our Guild!

source: ありがと！Ｔ．Ｔ．おじさん
translation: Thank you, Mister T.T.!

source:
はっはっは・・・詳しい説明は
ガストンから聞いてくれ
translation:
Hahaha... Gaston here will fill you
in on the rest of the details.

source:
それにしても驚いたなぁ・・・
Ｔ．Ｔ．おじさんがギルドマス
ターだなんて
translation:
Still, what a shocker... Who knew
he was the Guildmaster all along!

source:
すげぇお人だぜ。昔のアトラク
タってのはな、先代が悪さの限
りを尽くす暗黒街だったんだ
translation:
He's an amazing guy. Years ago,
Attracta was a lawless den run by
a rotten syndicate.

source:
それが、８年前にボスが現れて、
あっと言う間に叩き潰しちまっ
たんだ
translation:
Then eight years ago, our boss showed
up and tore them down in a heartbeat.

source: へえ～
translation: Wow, really?

source:
つまり、今のアトラクタがある
のは全てボスのおかげって言う
わけさ
translation:
Basically, everything good in this city
today is thanks to the boss.

source:
カリンって、すごい人と知り合
いだったんだね
translation:
You know some truly incredible
people, Karin.

source:
うーん・・・昔は、そんなすご
い人にはちっとも見えなかった
んだけどなぁ
translation:
Well... he certainly never looked
like much of a hero back then!

source:
おい！これから説明するから、
しっかり聞けよ
translation: Hey! Listen up, I'm explaining the rules!

source: あ、はいはい
translation: Yeah, yeah, we're listening.

source:
まずギルドってのは、冒険者に
しか解決できないような依頼を
一手に引き受けるところだ
translation:
First off, the Guild handles requests
that only adventurers can resolve.

source:
そして、難易度に応じて報酬額
を決め、お前たち冒険者に仕事
として発注する。
translation:
We assess the difficulty, set the reward,
and assign the jobs to adventurers.

source:
仕事が完了したら報酬を支払う
が、その一部をギルドに納めて
もらうってわけだ
translation:
When you complete a quest, you get paid,
with a small fee going to the Guild.

source:
右から左へのおいしい仕事って
わけね。
translation:
So you're just middle-men skimming
off the top, huh?

source:
でもそれだったら、ボクたちが
直接依頼を受けた方が
儲かるじゃない
translation:
Wouldn't we make way more by taking
requests directly from clients?

source:
ちっちっちっ、そこが甘いんだ
よなぁ。
translation:
Tsk, tsk, tsk. Spoken like a naive
greenhorn.

source:
得体の知れない馬の骨に、はい
よろしくと大金を支払って仕事
を頼むやつなんかいはいぜ
translation:
Nobody hands a bag of gold to some
random stranger with zero reputation!

source: えっ？
translation: Huh?

source:
みんな、ギルドが責任持って引
き受けてくれるから依頼を持っ
てくるんだ。
translation:
Clients come here because the Guild
guarantees the job gets done.

source:
この業界は信用が第一なんだよ。
お前たちにそれがあるのか？
translation:
Trust is everything in this business.
Do you two have that yet?

source: うっ・・・
translation: Urgh...

source:
それにな、メリットはそれだけ
じゃねぇ。
translation: Besides, that's not the only perk.

source:
ここに来れば苦労することなく、
自分の力量に合った仕事を得ら
れるし、
translation:
You get steady work matching your
rank without searching,

source:
万が一冒険に出かけて、何かト
ラブルがあった場合には救援隊
が派遣される
translation:
and if you get in over your head, a
rescue squad is dispatched to save you.

source:
なるほど。それなら悪くないわ
ね
translation: I see. That's actually pretty fair.

source:
そういう事だ。あと、これは必
ず守ってもらわんといけねぇん
だが、
translation:
Glad you agree. Now, here's the one
absolute rule you must follow:

source:
独自に情報を得てどこかへ出か
ける場合でも、必ずギルドに届
け出を出すこと
translation:
Even if you go somewhere on your own
leads, you MUST report it to the Guild.

source:
例えばお宝の噂を聞いて探しに
行くとかだな。こんな場合には、
translation:
Like hunting treasure from a rumor.
In situations like that,

source:
ギルドに手数料を納める必要は
ない。だが情報だけは絶対に伝
える事。いいな？
translation:
you don't owe any fee, but you must
share the intel. Got it?

source: 了解
translation: Understood.

source:
んじゃ、早速だがちょうどお前
さんたちに頼みたい仕事がある
んだ
translation:
Now then, I've got a job that's just
right for you two.

source:
この街の北西にでっかい屋敷が
あるのは知ってるか？
translation:
Know that big mansion in the
northwest district?

source:
あれはマクドガルさんて方の屋
敷で、この街で一番の商人だ。
translation:
That belongs to Master MacDougal,
the wealthiest merchant in town.

source:
暗黒時代だった８年前以前はヤ
バいことにも手を染めていたらし
いが、
translation:
Before our clean-up eight years ago,
he dabbed in shady business,

source:
今は真っ当に貿易で稼いでいる。
そのマクドガルさんの一人娘が、
どうやら家出したらしい。
translation:
but now he earns an honest living.
Anyway, his only daughter seems to have
run away from home.

source:
依頼は、娘さんを探し出して保
護する事。どうだ、受けるか？
translation:
Your job is to locate her and keep her
safe. Will you take it?

source: オーケー。いいわよ
translation: Sure, sounds good to me.

source:
よし。そっちの兄ちゃんもいい
のか？
translation: Great. What about you, lad?

source: カリンがいいなら
translation: If Karin wants to, I'm in.

source:
お前なぁ、男ならもうちっと自
分の意志をはっきり出せよ
translation:
Come on, man! Have some backbone and
speak for yourself!

source: ご、ごめんなさい
translation: S-Sorry...

source:
ちっ・・んじゃ、マクドガルさ
んとこで詳しい話を聞いてくれ
translation:
Tsk... Go over to MacDougal's place
and get the details from him.

source:
ボクたちには、子供探しがお似
合いってわけ！？
translation:
So you think babysitting runaways
is all we're good for?!

source:
いちいち怒るな！この仕事は、
お前さんたちでなきゃできない
訳があるんだ
translation:
Don't get your feathers ruffled! There's
a good reason this has to be you!

source: どういうことよ？
translation: And what reason is that?

source:
詳しい話はマクドガルさんとこ
へ行って聞いてくれ
translation:
Just go to MacDougal's and ask him
yourself!

source:
マクドガルさんのお屋敷か・・・
北西に見えるあれね？
translation:
MacDougal's estate, huh? That big
place to the northwest?

source: ん、どうした？
translation: Hmm? What is it?

source:
マクドガルさんのお屋敷ってど
こ？
translation: Where is MacDougal's mansion again?

source:
北西にある赤い屋根のでっかい
お屋敷だ！ちゃんと人の話を聞
けぇ！
translation:
The giant red-roofed mansion to the
northwest! Listen when people speak!

source: やあ、仕事の調子はどうだい？
translation: Hey there! How's the job going?

source: 今日から仕事だな。がんばれよ
translation:
Starting your first quest today, huh?
Best of luck!

source:
いらっしゃぁい！
いい武器が揃ってるよぉ！
translation: Welcome! Fine weapons for sale!

source:
おおっ！またのお越しを待って
るよぉ！
translation: Thank you! Please come again!

source: いらっしゃいませぇ！
translation: Welcome!

source: ありがとうございました！
translation: Thank you very much!

source: 外には出られない
translation: We can't leave town right now.

source: ・・・誰もいないね
translation: ...Nobody's here.

source: いいの？
translation: Is this alright?

source: いいんじゃないですか？
translation: I think it's fine.

source: すっごいお屋敷ね
translation: What a magnificent estate!

source: 本当だね
translation: It really is.

source:
よく来てくれたな。私がマクド
ガルだ。君たちが娘を探してく
れるのだね
translation:
Welcome. I am MacDougal. You must be
the ones searching for my daughter.

source:
はい。それで、詳しいお話を伺
いに参りました
translation: Yes, sir. We came to hear the details.

source:
うむ。まずは娘の似顔絵を見て
くれ
translation:
Indeed. First, please take a look at
her portrait.

source:
これが娘のアリスだ。服装もこ
れと同じもので出ていった
translation:
This is Alice. She left wearing these
exact clothes.

source:
アリスさんを探して連れてくれ
ばいいんですか？
translation: So we just need to bring her back?

source:
うむ・・だが、ちとまずいこと
になっていてな
translation:
Yes... though things are a bit
complicated, I'm afraid.

source: と言いますと？
translation: How so?

source:
・・もともとの始まりは、私と
の些細な口喧嘩なのだ。
translation:
...It all began with a petty quarrel
between us.

source:
あれは亡くなった母親に似て強
情でな。そう簡単に機嫌を直し
てくれるとは思えん
translation:
She takes after her late mother and is
stubborn as a mule. She won't return easily.

source: いったい、何が原因なんですか？
translation: What did you fight about?

source: うーむ・・・
translation: Umm...

source:
どうして？どうして外に遊びに
行っちゃいけないの？
translation:
'Why?! Why can't I ever go outside
to play?!

source:
外は物騒なのだ。お前のような
子供が出歩くには危なすぎる
translation:
The world is dangerous! It's too risky
for a child like you to wander about!

source:
私はもう、子供じゃないの。い
つまでも屋敷の中から外を眺め
てるのはイヤ！
translation:
I am not a child anymore! I hate being
cooped up staring out the window!

source:
聞き分けの無いことを
言うんじゃない。
translation: Don't talk such nonsense!

source:
外に行きたいのなら、私がいつ
も一緒に行ってやっているじゃ
ないか
translation:
Whenever you want to go out, I always
accompany you!

source:
私は、一人で、自由に出歩きた
いの！！これじゃ、籠の中の鳥
と同じじゃない！
translation:
I want to explore on my own, in freedom!
I'm like a caged bird in this house!

source: アリス・・・わかっておくれ。
translation: Alice... please understand.

source:
私は、死んだ母さんに代わって
お前を守らなくてはいけないん
だ
translation:
I promised your late mother that I would
protect you with my life!

source:
・・・パパがあくまでそういう
つもりなら、私にも考えがあり
ます
translation:
...If that's how you feel, Father, then
I have my own plans!

source: な、何をする気だね？
translation: Wh-What do you plan to do?!

source: 家を出ます
translation: I'm leaving home!'

source:
その時は、できっこと一笑
に付したのだか・・
translation:
I laughed it off at the time, thinking
she could never do it...

source:
ああ、まさか本当に出ていって
しまうなんて・・・
translation: Alas, to think she actually ran away...!

source:
なるほど・・・状況は大体わか
りました。そうなると、
translation:
I see... I understand the situation now.
In that case,

source:
たとえボクたちが見つけたとし
ても、素直に戻ってくれるとは
限らないわけですね
translation:
even if we find her, she won't just
quietly come home with us.

source: そうだ。だから娘を見つけたら、
translation: Precisely. So when you find her,

source:
連絡をした上で、危険のないよ
うあの子の側についていてやっ
てくれ
translation:
send word to me, and stay close to keep
her out of harm's way.

source:
でも・・そちらにも、護衛役の
人がいるんじゃないですか？
translation:
Wait... don't you have your own guards
for this kind of thing?

source:
うちの黒服では、また逃げ出し
てしまう。
translation:
If my bodyguards approach her, she'll
just bolt again.

source:
同年代の君たちなら、恐らく心
を許してくれるだろう
translation:
Since you two are roughly her age, she's
far more likely to trust you.

source:
なるほど。それでボクたちに・
・・
translation: Aha. That's why you hired us!

source:
一刻も早く娘を探し出してくれ。
ああっ、あの子に何かあったら、
私は、私は・・！
translation:
Please find her swiftly! If anything
happens to her, I... I couldn't bear it!

source:
心配しないで。ボクたちに任せ
て下さい
translation: Don't worry, sir. Leave it to us!

source:
ありがとう。君たちだけが頼り
だ
translation: Thank you. You're my only hope.

source:
とは言ったものの・・・どうし
よっか？
translation: Well, we promised... but what now?

source:
とりあえず、街の中を捜してみ
ようよ
translation: Let's start by asking around town.

source:
いらっしゃぁい！
いい武器が揃ってるよぉ！
translation: Welcome! Fine weapons for sale!

source: 景気のいいおじさんね
translation: Quite an energetic merchant.

source: ねぇねぇ、この子見なかった？
translation: Excuse me, have you seen this girl?

source:
んんー、その子ならさっきまで
いたなぁ。物珍しそうに武器を
見ていたけど、
translation:
Hmm... She was browsing weapons here
just a moment ago!

source:
他のお客が入ってきたら慌てて
出ていったよ
translation:
Then another customer walked in and she
ran out in a hurry.

source: そっかぁ・・
translation: I see...

source:
それはさておき！！女性の美を
いっそう輝かせる武器はいかが
かね！？
translation:
Never mind that! How about a weapon
to accentuate your feminine beauty?!

source: ねぇねぇ、この子来てない？
translation: Did she happen to come back?

source: あれからは来とらんなぁ
translation: Haven't seen her since.

source: いらっしゃいませぇ！
translation: Welcome!

source: あのー、この子見てませんか？
translation: Excuse me, have you seen this girl?

source:
あら、この子ならさっきハーブ
を買っていったわね。お友達？
translation:
Oh, she bought some herbs here earlier.
Is she a friend of yours?

source: え？え、まあ・・・
translation: Uh... yeah, something like that...

source:
あなたもどう？お安くしとくわ
よん
translation:
Care for some herbs too? I'll give
you a special discount!

source: あれから来てませんか？
translation: Has she stopped by again?

source: 来てないわ。ごめんなさいね
translation: No, sorry, dear.

source:
ここは、薬草とかを売ってる所
ね
translation: This place sells medicinal herbs.

source:
あのー、この子見かけませんで
した？
translation: Pardon me, did you see this girl?

source:
ああ、見た見た。ここにゃ不釣
り合いの服だったから覚えてる
よ。
translation:
Oh, I saw her! Stood out like a sore
thumb in those fancy clothes!

source:
ずーっと海の向こうを眺めてい
たなぁ
translation: She was staring out at the sea for ages.

source: あれから来てませんか？
translation: Has she been back since?

source: 見てないなぁ
translation: Nope, not a peep.

source:
あのー、この子見かけませんで
した？
translation: Excuse me, did you see this girl?

source:
この子でしたら、先程まで
いらっしゃいましたよ。
translation: Why yes, she was here just a while ago!

source:
確か、プリン・ア・ラ・モードを
注文されたと思いますけど
translation: She ordered our pudding à la mode.

source: 一足遅かったか
translation: Just missed her again!

source: で、ご注文は何になさいますか？
translation: May I take your order as well?

source: あれから来てませんか？
translation: Has she returned at all?

source: お見えになっていませんわ
translation: No, she hasn't.

source: 他を探すしかないか・・・
translation: Guess we have to check elsewhere...

source: ご注文・・・
translation: Your order, sir...?

source:
マスター、この子見かけなかっ
た？
translation: Barkeep, did you see this girl?

source:
ああ、さっき来た。まだ準備中
だよって言ったら残念そうに出
ていったな
translation:
Yeah, stopped by earlier. Left looking
disappointed when I said we were closed.

source: こんにちわ、マスター。どう？
translation: Hello again, barkeep. Any sign of her?

source: お疲れ様。あの後は来てないよ
translation: Keep at it, kid. Haven't seen her since.

source:
ええっ！？アリスちゃん家出し
ちゃったんですの！？
translation: WHAT?! Alice ran away from home?!

source: どこかで見かけなかった？
translation: Have you seen her anywhere?

source:
見たも何も、さっきまで一緒に
お話してたです
translation:
Seen her? We were chatting right here
just minutes ago!

source:
ええっ！？それで、どこに行っ
たの？
translation: Really?! Where did she go?

source:
わかんないです・・・まさか、
家出中だなんて思わなかったで
すぅ
translation:
I don't know... I had no idea she was
running away!

source: 何か、変わった事はなかった？
translation: Did she say or do anything unusual?

source:
そう言えば、大きな風呂敷包み
背負ってたです
translation:
Now that you mention it, she was lugging
a huge travel pack!

source:
・・・（そこで変だと気付きな
さいよ）
translation: ...(You should have noticed right then!)

source:
あ、あたしも一緒にアリスちゃ
んを探しに行くです！
translation: I-I'll come help search for Alice too!

source:
でも、ここを空っぽにしちゃっ
てもいいの？
translation: Are you allowed to leave the church empty?

source:
ああっ、夕方まで抜けられない
ですぅ
translation: Aww, I can't leave until evening!

source:
あー・・・それじゃ、もしまた
こっちに寄るようなことがあっ
たら、
translation: Ah... Well, if she swings by again,

source: ギルドまで連絡してくれる？
translation: could you let the Guild know right away?

source: ううう・・わかったのです。
translation: Uuu... Understood!

source:
あたし、この教会で
短期シスターのバイトをしてい
るラディッシュっていいますぅ
translation:
I'm Radish! I work part-time as a nun
at this chapel.

source: ボクはカリン。こっちはアルね
translation: I'm Karin, and this is Al.

source: あ、よろしく
translation: Nice to meet you.

source: よろしくです！
translation: Pleasure to meet you!

source:
アリスちゃん
見つかったですかぁ？
translation: Any luck finding Alice yet?

source: ・・・まだ
translation: ...Not yet.

source: （うるうるうるうる）
translation: (sniffling with teary eyes)

source:
んもぉっ！いったいあの子、ど
こをうろついているのよっ！？
translation:
Geez! Where on earth could that girl
be wandering off to?!

source:
これだけ街中歩いていたら、い
いかげん疲れるんじゃないかな
・・・？
translation:
After walking all over town, she's got
to be tired out by now, right?

source: ん？まだ見つかんねぇのか？
translation: Hmm? Still haven't found her?

source:
まあ、街の外に出るこたねぇと
思うから、隅々まで廻ってみた
らどうだい？
translation:
She couldn't have left town. Check every
nook and cranny!

source:
誰もいない・・こんなところに
来るわけないか
translation:
Nobody here... Guess she wouldn't come
to a place like this.

source:
・・・ここはボクにまかせて。
アルは、先にギルドに報告して
おいてくれる？
translation:
...Leave this to me. Al, can you head
back and inform the Guild?

source: わかったよ
translation: Got it.

source: きれいな街ね
translation: It's a beautiful town, isn't it?

source: ・・・うん
translation: ...Yes.

source:
昨日この街に着いたばっかり
だったんだけど…こんないいと
ころがあるなんて知らなかった
translation:
I only arrived yesterday, but I had no
idea such a lovely spot existed.

source:
パパに、頼まれて来たんでしょ？
連れて行かないの？
translation:
My father sent you, didn't he?
Aren't you going to drag me home?

source:
そこまでは頼まれてないの。
見つけたら、一緒についていて
やってくれって
translation:
He didn't ask me to do that. Just to stay
by your side and keep you safe.

source: そう・・・
translation: Is that so...?

source: お父さん、心配してたよ
translation: Your father was worried sick about you.

source: いつものことよ
translation: He always is.

source:
そう？でも羨ましいな・・あん
なに心配してくれる人がいて
translation:
Maybe, but I'm jealous... Having someone
who cares that much about you.

source: あなたにはいないの？
translation: Don't you have anyone like that?

source:
８年前に、エントリヒで起こっ
た戦争を覚えてる？ボク、その
ころエントリヒに住んでて・・
translation:
Remember the war on Entrich eight years
ago? I was living there back then...

source: パパもママも、その時・・
translation: My father and mother, they both...

source: ごめんなさい・・・
translation: I'm so sorry...

source: 気にしないで。もう慣れたから
translation: Don't worry about it. I'm used to it now.

source:
ねえ・・・冒険者って楽しいで
すか？
translation: Say... is being an adventurer fun?

source: え？
translation: Huh?

source:
ちょっと憧れてたんです。自由
に世界中を旅して、色んなもの
を見れて・・・
translation:
I've always dreamed about it. Traveling
the world freely, seeing all kinds of sights...

source:
うーん・・自由って言っても、
やっぱり稼がないと食べていけ
ないし、
translation:
Well... freedom is nice, but if you don't
earn coin, you don't eat.

source:
それほど好き勝手できるわけ
じゃないんだけどね
translation: It's not all fun and games, honestly.

source:
でも・・私はこの街の外を知ら
ないし、屋敷の外すら滅多に出
たことがないの
translation:
Still... I know nothing of the world outside.
I barely ever stepped foot out of the manor.

source: それで、ここで街を見てたの…
translation: That's why I came here to look at the city...

source:
・・もう少ししたら帰ります。
そうパパに伝えてくれませんか？
translation:
...I will return home soon. Could you
please tell my father that?

source:
いいけど・・・キミを見守るよ
うに言われてるし
translation: I could, but my job is to watch over you.

source:
お願い・・もう少しここに一人
でいたいんです
translation: Please... I just want a few moments alone.

source: ・・・うん
translation: ...Alright.

source: マクドガルんとこの娘かい？
translation: You're MacDougal's girl?

source: 遅いなぁ・・・
translation: They're taking a long time...

source: 大変！大変ですぅ！
translation: Emergency! We have a huge problem!

source: どうしたんですか？
translation: What's wrong?

source:
アリスちゃん、誘拐されちゃっ
たです！
translation: Alice has been kidnapped!

source: ええっ！？詳しく話して！
translation: WHAT?! Tell us everything!

source:
教会のバイトが終わって、アリ
スちゃんを空から探そうとした
んです。そうしたら・・・
translation:
My church shift ended, so I flew up to
search from the sky, and then...

source: ・・・と言うわけなんですぅ
translation: ...And that's what happened!

source: はうぅ・・・
translation: Haaauuu...

source:
あ、でも、犯人さんの居場所は
ちゃんと確かめてきましたです
translation:
Oh, but I tracked down where the thugs
took her!

source: えらいっ！で、それはどこ？
translation: Good job! Where are they?!

source:
えへへ・・・港にある大きい倉
庫ですの
translation:
Ehehe... In the big warehouse down
by the harbor!

source: 行こう、アル！
translation: Let's go, Al!

source: わかったよ
translation: Right behind you!

source:
ガストン、マクドガルさんを頼
むね
translation: Gaston, take care of Master MacDougal!

source: あいよ、気をつけてな
translation: You got it. Stay on your toes!

source: ア、アリスは・・・？
translation: Is Alice... safe?!

source: え、えーと・・・まだです・・
translation: Er, well... not quite yet...

source: はうぅ・・・
translation: Oh dear me...

source: バカ野郎！早く行きやがれ！！
translation: You fools! Get out there and save her!

source: ど、どうしましょう？
translation: Wh-What should we do?

source:
意外と少ないわね・・・ちょっ
とみんな耳を貸して
translation:
Fewer guards than I expected... Everyone,
listen up for the plan.

source: 退屈だな・・・
translation: Man, this is boring...

source:
ああ。早くガキの見張りから解
放されてぇや
translation:
Yeah. I can't wait to be done babysitting
this brat.

source: そこまでよ！悪人ども！
translation: Hold it right there, you scoundrels!

source: 何っ！？
translation: What?!

source: だっ、誰だっ！？
translation: Wh-Who's there?!

source:
いたいけな少女をかどわかす、
むさ苦しい男たちっ！
translation:
Vile brutes preying upon an innocent
young lady!

source:
このボクが、天に代わってこら
しめてやる！
translation:
In the name of the heavens, I shall
punish you!

source: 何だ・・・またガキか
translation: What's this? Another little squirt?

source:
レディに向かってガキとは
何よっ！？ガキとは！？
translation:
How dare you call a lady a squirt!
A squirt, of all things?!

source:
こいつ、マクドガルの手のモン
か？
translation: Is this kid working for MacDougal?

source: こんなガキがか？冗談だろ
translation: A brat like this? You gotta be joking!

source: わっはっはっはっ
translation: Wahahaha!

source: さぁて、どうする？
translation: So, what'll it be?

source: どうしようかね
translation: How should we play with her?

source: な、何をするつもりよ！？
translation: Wh-What do you think you're doing?!

source:
なぁに、レディなら、それらし
く扱ってやろうってんだよ
translation:
Nothing much, just giving a 'lady' the
proper treatment!

source:
ちょ、ちょっと！？それ以上近
づくと、許さないわよ！
translation:
H-Hold on! Come any closer and you'll
regret it!

source: 許さないだけなのかなぁ？
translation: Regret it, will we? And what'll you do?

source: こっ、来ないで！
translation: D-Don't come near me!

source: ひっひっひっひっひっ
translation: Hehehehehe!

source: アルぅ。もういいわよ
translation: Al, now's our chance!

source: てってめぇ！？
translation: Wh-Who the hell are you?!

source: ふっふっふ。驚いた？
translation: Fufufu! Surprised?

source: 美人局だったのか！？
translation: A badger game setup?!

source: 違うわよっ！！
translation: NO, IT'S NOT A BADGER GAME!!

source: あの～、美人局って何ですか？
translation: Um... what's a badger game?

source:
美人局ってのはだな、まず女が
男を引っかけて、
translation:
It's when a pretty girl lures a guy into
a compromising spot,

source:
隠れていた仲間が難癖つけて金
を巻き上げると。まあそういう
ことだ。俺たちもよくやる
translation:
and her hidden thugs jump out to shake
him down. We do it all the time.

source:
なるほど。丁寧にありがとうご
ざいます
translation: I see. Thank you for the detailed explanation.

source: いや何、いいってことよ
translation: Don't mention it, kid.

source: そこっ！悪人と馴れ合わない！
translation:
HEY! Stop making polite chitchat with
the criminals!!

source: は、はいっ！
translation: Y-Yes, ma'am!

source:
とにかく、アリスは返してもら
うわよ！
translation: Anyway, hand Alice back to us right now!

source: へっ、そうはさせるかい！
translation: Hah! Like hell we will!

source: なっ、何だと！？
translation: What did you say?!

source: てっ、てめえら！いつのまに！
translation: Wh-When did you slip behind us?!

source: さあっ！観念しなさい！
translation: Give up! You're surrounded!

source: うるせぇっ！
translation: Shut your traps!

source: やっちまえ！
translation: Get 'em, boys!

source:
ラディッシュ、早くパパに知ら
せて！
translation: Radish, go notify Alice's father!

source: は、はいです
translation: Y-Yes, right away!

source: 回復魔法！？
translation: Healing magic?!

source:
気をつけて！私から離れないで
下さい！
translation: Watch out! Stay close to me!

source:
アリス！？
やたっ、百人力だわ！
translation: Alice?! Awesome, you're a lifesaver!

source: 何とか片づいたかな？
translation: Looks like that takes care of them!

source:
そ、そんなぁ～・・・私はどう
すればいいんですかぁ？
translation:
N-No way... What am I supposed
to do now?!

source: 誰か降ろして下さ～い・・・
translation: Someone please get me down from here...!

source: パパ！
translation: Father!

source: アリス！
translation: Alice!

source: ううう・・・感動的ですぅ
translation: Uuu... How touching and wonderful!

source: よかったね
translation: All's well that ends well.

source: うん
translation: Yeah.

source:
お早うさん。さ、昨日の仕事の
報酬だ
translation:
Good morning. Here is the reward
for yesterday's job.

source:
たったこれだけ！？マクドガル
さんって、この街一番のお金持
ちじゃないのぉ！？
translation:
Only this much?! Isn't MacDougal
the wealthiest man in town?!

source:
相手が誰だろうと、ギルドの規
定価格は変わらねぇの。
translation:
No matter who the client is,
guild rates are strictly set.

source:
誤解だって、元を正せばこちら
が目を離したせいだからね。超
過勤務手当もナシだ
translation:
Besides, that mess happened because
you looked away. No overtime pay.

source: ふーんだ、ケチ！
translation: Hmph, cheapskate!

source:
あ、いえ、決してマクドガルさ
んがケチと言うわけじゃ・・・
translation:
Ah, no, I certainly didn't mean
Mister MacDougal was cheap...

source: えっ、大変だ！
translation: Oh no! Huge trouble!

source: はい？
translation: Yes?

source: アリスがまた家出した！！
translation: Alice has run away from home again!!

source: ええええ～～～！？
translation: Whaaaat? Again?!

source: 今度は何があったんですか？
translation: What happened this time?

source:
アリスめ、とんでもないことを
言い出しよった
translation:
Alice came out with the most
outrageous declaration.

source: と言いますと？
translation: And what might that be?

source: 私、冒険者になる！！
translation: 'I'm going to become an adventurer!!'

source: え、それはちょっと・・・
translation: Uh, isn't that a bit much...?

source:
だが、あの子は言い出したら止
まらないのだ
translation:
Once she sets her mind on something,
nothing can stop her.

source:
実は、今日は君たちに頼みが
あって来たのだ
translation:
Actually, I came today to ask
a favor of you two.

source: 何ですか？
translation: What kind of favor?

source:
うむ、実は、あの子の面倒を見
てやってほしくてな。
translation:
Well, I would like you to look
after her on her journey.

source: えええっ！？
translation: Whaaaat?!

source:
そうなのじゃ。私もあの子を、荒く
れ者の男たちの中に入れるこ
とは絶対にできん
translation:
Indeed. I could never allow her
to run around with roughneck brutes.

source: ふーん
translation: Hmm...

source:
だが、君たちになら、預けても
いいような気がするのだ
translation:
With you two, however, I feel she
would be in trustworthy hands.

source: え、でも・・・
translation: Uh, but still...

source:
アリスの母親は癒し手だった。
あの子がまだ小さいときに亡く
なったが、
translation:
Alice's mother was a healer. She
passed away when Alice was small,

source:
簡単な回復魔法を教えていたよ
うだ。きっと、役に立つことも
あるはずだ
translation:
but she taught her healing magic.
She will surely be of help to you.

source: ま、ま・・・確かに
translation: W-Well, that is true...

source:
それに、考えてみればあの子に
は、同じ年頃の友達がほとんど
いない。
translation:
Besides, she has never really had
friends her own age.

source:
もちろん私のせいなのだが、今
ではすまないと思っているの
だ
translation:
That is my fault, and I feel
terribly remorseful for it.

source: マクドガルさん
translation: Mister MacDougal...

source:
すみません
カリンさんいます？
・・・って、パパ！？
translation:
Excuse me, is Karin here?
...Wait, Papa?!

source: アリス！待ちなさい！
translation: Alice! Wait!

source:
今、カリンさんたちにお願いし
ていたところだ。お前の面倒を
見て欲しいとな
translation:
I was just asking Karin and her
partner to take you under their wing.

source: パパ・・・それじゃ・・・
translation: Papa... does that mean...?

source: うむ、快く承知して下さった
translation: Yes, they graciously agreed!

source:
いえ、あの、まだお返事してな
いんですけど
translation:
Wait a second, we haven't even
said yes yet!

source: パパ、ありがとう！
translation: Oh, Papa! Thank you so much!

source:
うむ、お前もどうかと思っては
ゆくのだが・・・寂しいが仕方
が無い
translation:
Yes, well... I will miss you terribly,
but growing up means letting go.

source: パパ・・・ごめんなさい
translation: Papa... I'm so sorry.

source: あのー、もしもし？
translation: Excuse me... hello? Anyone listening?

source:
観念しなよ。いいじゃねえか、
頑張っているとこ強いぜ？
translation:
Just give in. It's a fine thing
to see a kid try so hard.

source: まあ、そうなんだけどね
translation: Well, that is true, but...

source:
マクドガルさん、色々支度もあ
るでしょうから、ボクたち宿屋
で待ってます
translation:
Mister MacDougal, you'll need to pack.
We'll wait for her at the inn.

source: うむ、娘をよろしく頼む
translation: Thank you. Please take good care of her.

source: じゃあ、またあとでね
translation: See you soon, Alice!

source: はい、よろしくお願いします！
translation: Yes! Thank you very much!

source: おや？アリスって娘はどうした？
translation: Where did that Alice girl go?

source:
いけない！！宿屋で待ち合わせし
てたんだ！
translation:
Oh no! We promised to meet her
at the inn!

source:
マクドガルさんも心配症だね。
こんなに支度金を持たせるなん
て
translation:
Mister MacDougal sure worries a lot.
Giving you this much pocket money!

source:
ええ、でも、私はそんなに必要
無いんで、皆さんで好きなよう
に使って下さい
translation:
Yes, but I don't need all this,
so please spend it as you like!

source:
ええっ？でも、そういうわけに
も・・・
translation: Wait, really? We couldn't possibly...

source: でお！？ありがとう！！
translation: Score! Thanks, Alice!!

source:
パパったら、宿代や生活費まで
全部出すって言うのよ。
translation:
Papa insisted on paying for all our
lodgings and living expenses too.

source:
でも、それじゃ外に出た意味が
ないわ。こうって断ったの
translation:
But that would defeat the point of
leaving, so I flatly refused.

source: そうか。偉いんだね
translation: Is that so? Good for you!

source: ほ、本当ね・・・（チェッ）
translation: R-Right... quite admirable... (Tch!)

source:
それで、今日の仕事は何です
か？
translation: So, what is our mission for today?

source:
そうね。ギルドに行ってみよっ
か
translation: Let's head to the Guild and find out!

source: 早速だが仕事がある
translation: Good timing. A request just came in.

source: 届け物を
translation: A delivery job...?

source:
子供が一人、ここから少し遠い
ところにある山で迷子になった
そうだ
translation:
A young child has gotten lost in the
mountains a little ways from here.

source:
大したモンスターのいるところ
じゃないが、子供にとっちゃ命
に関わる。
translation:
Monsters there aren't strong, but
for a child it's life-threatening.

source:
急いで助けに行ってやって欲し
い。どうだ、受けるか？
translation:
We need someone to rescue them fast.
Will you take the job?

source: いいよ
translation: We'll do it!

source: また子供・・・
translation: Another lost kid...?

source:
俺たちだと、助けに行っても子
供の方が怖がって逃げちまうん
だ。頼むよ
translation:
When my boys go, the children run
away terrified. We're counting on you.

source: わかったわよぉ
translation: Alright, alright, we're on it.

source:
そうそう、最近、通り魔が出る
らしいんだ
translation:
Oh, by the way, beware of a robber
wandering the outskirts lately.

source:
道で一人歩きの男を呼び止めて
は、懐を探り、有り金を全部巻
き上げて行くらしい
translation:
Stops lone men on the road, searches
their pockets, and robs them blind.

source: 通り魔！？
translation: A mugger?!

source:
お前さんとこの兄ちゃんは気を
つけた方がいいだろう
translation:
Your young lad there should keep
his wits about him.

source:
まあ、常に二人でいれば大丈夫
だろうけどよ
translation:
Though if you stick together, you
should be fine.

source: ありがとよ。注意しとくね
translation: Thanks for the tip. We'll be careful.

source:
と、言うわけで、ちょっと遠出
になるの
translation: So, we have quite a trek ahead of us.

source: 初仕事ですね！？ワクワク
translation: Our very first quest together! How exciting!

source: がんばってね
translation: Let's do our best.

source: ん？どうしたんだ？
translation: Hm? Something wrong?

source:
はい、迷子さんの居場所はどこ
ですか？
translation: Yes, where exactly is the lost child?

source:
・・・ここから少し離れた山ん
中だ
translation: ...Up in the mountains a ways off.

source: 山の中のどこかはわからんが？
translation: Though where in the mountain, who knows?

source:
あのな、迷子ってのは、居場所
がわからないから迷子って言う
んだ
translation:
Listen, kid. A lost child is called
'lost' because no one knows where!

source: そう言えばそうですね
translation: Now that you mention it, that's true.

source:
だから、探して来て欲しいんだ。
俺が言ってること、わかるよな？
translation:
That's why you're searching for them.
Get what I'm saying?

source: わかりました、行って来ます
translation: Understood! We're on our way.

source: ・・・大丈夫かね？
translation: ...Will they be alright?

source: 見つけた！
translation: Found you!

source: ひっどーい！
translation: Gross!

source: クサいです・・・
translation: It stinks...

source: この子も泥だらけだね
translation: The poor child is covered in mud.

source:
街まではまだ遠いし・・・そう
だ！
translation:
The town is still far away...
Wait, I know!

source:
確か、ちょっと戻ったところに
泉があったから身体を洗って行
こうよ
translation:
There was a spring back there.
Let's wash up before heading back.

source:
そうだね。僕もこのままじゃ気
持ち悪いし・・・
translation: Good idea. I feel gross like this too...

source: キミは見張り役
translation: You're on lookout duty!

source: ええっ！？そんなぁ
translation: Whaaat?! Not fair!

source:
当たり前でしょ！？レディが3
人よ！？
translation: Of course! There are three ladies here!

source: う・・・ごめんなさい
translation: Ugh... sorry.

source: それとね、もう一つ
translation: And another thing!

source: 何ですか？
translation: What is it?

source: 可愛い子3人いるわよ
translation: There are three pretty girls here!

source: はい・・・
translation: Yes ma'am...
(Dazed staring...)

source: キャーーーッ！冷たーい！
translation: Eeeek! It's freezing!

source:
やだっ、カリンさんったら。
キャッ！水をかけないで下さい！
translation:
Stop it, Karin! Eeek!
Don't splash me!

source: 楽しかったなあ・・・
translation: Sounds like they're having fun...

source: おい、お前
translation: Hey, you.

source: お前、剣士か？
translation: You a swordsman?

source: えーと、一応
translation: Uh... yeah, somewhat.

source: なら、あたいと勝負しな
translation: Then draw your sword and fight me!

source: ええっ！？そんなぁ
translation: Whaaat?! Why out of nowhere?!

source:
あたいに勝ったら、あたいを好
きなようにしていいよ
translation:
If you beat me, I'm all yours to do
whatever you want with.

source:
ただし、負けたら有り金全部置
いて行きな
translation:
Lose, and you leave every coin you
have right here.

source: えっ、そんな、いきなり！
translation: Wait, that's completely crazy!

source: 問答無用！行くぜっ！
translation: No more talk! Have at you!

source: 待ちなさいっ！！
translation: Hold it right there!!
Aaaah!

source: カッ、カリン！？
translation: K-Karin?!

source: のぞいたわね！？
translation: You peeked, didn't you?!

source: い・・・いや、そんなつもりじゃ・・・

見守っていておくれ・・・
translation:
So please... watch over us from
the heavens above...

translation: Hey, Alice.

source: 何ですか？

source:
教会でシスターのアルバイトを
しているラディッシュさんって
知り合い？
translation:
Do you know Radish, that girl
working part-time at the church?

source:
ええ。小さい頃に、よく遊んで
もらっていたんです
translation:
Yes. She used to play with me all
the time when I was little.

source:
あの人、仲間に入ってくれない
かなぁ
translation:
I wonder if she'd be willing to join
our party.

source: ラディッシュさんをですか？
translation: You mean Radish?

source:
うん・・昨日屋根の上で戦って

る人が一人いると、
translation:
Yeah... After fighting up on that roof,
I realized having someone who can fly

全然違うのよね。おまけに、セ
イレーンって歌の魔法も強力だ
し
translation:
would be a game-changer. Plus, a Siren's
song magic is incredibly powerful!

source:
私も、ラディッシュさんが入っ
てくれるなら嬉しいです。
あっ！でも確か・・・
translation:
I would love to have her with us! Ah!
Wait a moment, though...

source: どうしたの？
translation: What's wrong?

source:
私、小さかった頃に
ラディッシュさんに子守歌をね
だったことがあったんです。
translation:
When I was young, I once begged Radish
to sing me a lullaby.

source:
そうしたら、ラディッシュさん
悲しい顔をして、『私は歌えな
いの。ごめんね』って・・・
translation:
She looked so sorrowful and said,
'I can't sing. I'm sorry...'

source:
セイレーンが歌えない！？うそ
でしょ？
translation:
A Siren who can't sing?! You've got
to be kidding!

source: 私も、それで聞いたんです。

source:
そうしたら、小さい頃に呪いを
かけられて、それから歌えなく
なったんだって
translation:
She told me someone cursed her as a child,
and she hasn't been able to sing since.

source: そんな・・・

source:
確かに、そんな呪いがあったな。
あたいも呪術士のはしくれだか
ら、よく知ってるよ
translation:
Indeed, such curses exist. As a practitioner
of hexes, I know of it well.

source:
でも、セイレーンほどの歌の名
手なら、１０年もすれば自然に
解けるはずなんだけど
translation:
Yet for a born singer like a Siren,
it should naturally fade within a decade.

source:
私が話を聞いたのは１０年も前
です
translation:
The time she told me that was ten
years ago!

source:
もうとっくに呪いは解けてるっ
てわけね。それじゃあ、早速ス
カウトに行くわよ！
translation:
Then her curse must already be broken!
Come on, let's go recruit her right now!

source:
そうですか・・折角ですけどあ
たしではお役に立てません・・・
translation:
I see... I appreciate the offer, but I'm
afraid I would be of no use to you...

source:
どうして！？もうキミの呪いは
解けているのよ？
translation:
Why not?! Your curse should be completely
lifted by now!

source:
それでも、歌えないんです。
いえ、歌うのが恐いんです。
translation:
Even so, I cannot sing. To be honest,
I am terrified of singing.

source: 恐い？
translation: Terrified?

source:
歌えないセイレーンが、どう思
われるか知ってますか？小さい
頃は、よく
translation:
Do you know how a Siren who cannot sing
is treated? When I was little,

source:
それでいじめられたものです。
この街に来たのも、故郷の島に
いるのが辛かったから
translation:
they mocked and bullied me constantly.
I fled my island home just to escape it.

source: そんな・・・
translation: Oh, Radish...

source:
だから、仲間にはなれないんで
す・・・ごめんなさい・・・
translation:
So I cannot join you... I am truly
sorry...

source:
そんなことがあったんですか・
・・
translation: I had no idea you went through that...

source:
要するに、身体に歌うことに対
する恐怖が染み付いちゃってい
るんだな。
translation:
In short, trauma has ingrained fear of
singing right into her very soul.

source:
こればっかりは、さすがにどう
しようもないね
translation: There's nothing we can do about trauma.

source: あきらめるしかないのかなぁ
translation: I guess we have to give up for now.

source:
よっ、何しけたツラしてんだ？
仕事だぜ。しかも、あんたらを
ご指名だ
translation:
Yo! Why the long faces? We got a quest!
What's more, it's a direct request for you!

source: ボクたちに？
translation: A request for us?

source:
あたいらってそんなに有名なの
か？
translation: Are we really that famous already?

source: そんなわけないでしょ
translation: Not a chance.

source: 説明するぜ
translation: Here's the situation.

source:
とある大金持ちの屋敷に、今夜強
盗が入るというタレ込みがあっ
た。
translation:
We received an anonymous tip that robbers
will hit a wealthy tycoon's mansion tonight.

source:
そこで、今夜屋敷の警備を行っ
て欲しい。どうだ、受けるか？
translation:
They want guards posted at the manor
tonight. Will you take the case?

source: とある大金持？
translation: A wealthy tycoon...?

source: まさか・・・
translation: Don't tell me...

source: そう、私の家だ
translation: Yes, my residence.

source: パパ！？
translation: Papa!?

source: アリス、久しぶりだな

source:
パパ！これはいったいどういう

source:
話は聞いただろう？君たちに屋
敷の警備を依頼したいのだ

You heard Gaston. I wish to hire your party
to guard my estate tonight.

source:
でも、家には専属の黒服部隊が
いるじゃない！？
translation:
Doesn't our estate have a whole unit of
personal bodyguards in black suits?!

source:
みんな休暇で出払っとる。
恐らく、そこを狙ってきたのだ
ろうな
translation:
They are all away on leave. The bandits
undoubtedly chose tonight for that reason.

source:
だからってどうして私たちに・
・他の人に頼めばいいじゃな
い！
translation:
Even so, why hire us?! There are plenty
of other adventurers!

source:
お前はプロとしてやっていくの
に、仕事の選り好みをするのか
ね？
translation:
If you truly intend to be a professional,
do you dare be picky about commissions?

source:
それでは子供と変わらんな。
家に帰ってきた方がいいんじゃ
ないか？
translation:
A true pro never turns down an honest job.
Perhaps you should just come home?

source: そんな・・・！

source:
プロなら立派に仕事を成し遂げ
て見せろ。そうすれば私も認め
てやる。いいな
translation:
Prove your professionalism by doing this job
flawlessly. Then I shall acknowledge you.

source:
・・・なぁ、俺から言うのも何
なんだが、マクドガルさんの言
うことももっともだ。
translation:
...Look, it's not my place to pry, but
Mister MacDougal makes a fair point.

source:
親父さんに認めてもらいたいな
ら、文句の付け所も無いくらい
完璧にやってみせろや
translation:
If you want your old man's respect, do the
job so well he can't say a single thing.

source:
そうだよ。親父さんを見返して
やるいいチャンスじゃないか
translation:
Exactly. This is your chance to show him
what you're made of!

source:
そうですね！
・・・わかりました。
私、やります！
translation:
You're right!
...Understood.
I will do it!

source: んじゃ、引き受けるんだな？
translation: So, you accept the contract?

source: はい！！
translation: Yes!!

source:
いいの？カリン。何か話がどん
どん進んでいってるけど
translation:
Are you sure, Karin? Things seem to
be moving awfully fast.

source:
いいんじゃない？何かうさん臭
いけど、アリスのためにも一肌
脱いでやりましょ
translation:
Why not? It smells fishy, but let's
lend Alice a hand anyway.

source:
決まりだな。それじゃ、日が暮
れる前にマクドガルさんの屋敷
に行ってくれ
translation:
It's settled then. Report to the MacDougal
manor before dusk.

source:
じゃあ、マクドガルさんの屋敷
に行く？
translation: Shall we head to the manor now?

source:
まだ日も高いし、準備してから
にしましょ
translation:
The sun is still high. Let's finish our
preparations first.

source:
日が暮れるまでにはマクドガル
さんとこに行ってくれよ
translation: Make sure you're at the estate before sunset.

source:
で、ボクたちはどうすれば良い
の？
translation: So, where should we stand guard?

source:
賊が来たら、ここで迎え撃って
くれ
translation:
Stand here and intercept any intruders
who break in.

source: ブッ殺しちまってもいいよな？
translation: Can we slice 'em to ribbons?

source: いっ、いや！それはまずい

source: どうして？
translation: Why not?

source:
わっ・・私は野蛮なことは嫌い
なのだ。

source:
とにかく、賊を追い払ってくれ
るだけで十分だからな！
translation:
Just drive them away, that will be
more than enough!

source:
なーんでさぁ。バレバレもいい
とこだよな
translation: Good grief. Could this be any more obvious?

source: まっ、適当にやりましょ？

source:
あの・・・適当にやったらまず
いんじゃ
translation: Um... shouldn't we take guard duty seriously?

source:
いいんです・・どうせ来るのは
パパが雇ったサクラですから
translation:
It's fine... The 'robbers' are just actors
Papa hired to test us anyway.

source: ええっ！？
translation: Whaaaat?!

source:
ごめんなさい・・いくら私が心
配だからって、ここまでするな
んて・・・
translation:
I'm so sorry... To think Papa would go
this far just out of worry for me...

source:
ま、仕事は仕事だもんね。気に
しなくていいわよ
translation:
Well, business is business. Don't worry
about it!

source: ・・・どうやら、来たようだぜ

source: まっ、魔物！？
translation: M-Monsters?!

source: こいつら、賊なんじゃねぇ！
translation: These aren't hired thugs!

source: どういうこと！？
translation: What is going on here?!
This can't be...!

source:
何っ！？
これはどういうことだ！？
translation: What?! What is the meaning of this?!

source: うわああああああっ！！
translation: GYAAAAAHHH!!

source: パパ！？
translation: Papa!?

source: しまった！こっちは囮！？
translation: Blast it! This side was a diversion?!

source: 完全に裏をかかれたわね

source:
へっ。だったら、蹴散らしてや
るぜっ！

translation: On the second floor! Hurry!

source: おっさん、無事でいろよ！

source: マクドガルさん！？しっかり！
translation: Mister MacDougal?! Pull yourself together!
Urrgh... uhhh...

大丈夫。気絶しているだけみた
いだ

translation: Did she get lost?

自分の家でそんなわけない

translation: How could she get lost in her own mansion?!

source: ごっ、ごめんなさい
translation: S-Sorry!

translation: Oh no! Alice?!

source:
ま、マクドガルに、伝えろ・・
・これは、警告、だ・・

source:
む娘の命が大事なら、ば、
て、手を引け、とな・・・
translation:
If he values his daughter's life... he
will back off...!

source:
まさか、最初からアリスちゃん
が狙いだったとは・・・
translation: So Alice was their target all along...

source:
私が、つまらぬことをしたばか
りに・・
translation: Because of my foolish charade...

source:
マクドガルさんのせいじゃない
よ
translation: It isn't your fault, Mister MacDougal.

source:
しかし・・・これで、アリスの
身に何かあったら・・・私は・
・・

But... if anything happens to Alice, I
will never forgive myself...

source:
奴ら、『手を引け』って言って
たよな。あんた、魔物を怒らす
ようなことしたのかい？
translation:
They said 'back off'. Did you do something
to cross the monsters, old man?

source:
近頃、海賊が近海を荒らし
まわっているのは知ってる
かい？
translation:
You know how pirates have terrorized the coast
lately?

海賊王デュマだろ？魔物を操っ
て商船を襲っては、皆殺しにす
るって話だな
translation:
Pirate King Dumas, right? Raiding merchant
vessels with monsters and butchering everyone.

それでも、最近は我々が指揮す
る自警団の働きで、奴らもなか
なか手が出せないでいる。
translation:
Yet our town watch has successfully driven
them back recently.

source:
その自警団のメインスポンサー
がマクドガル氏なんだ
translation:
And Mister MacDougal is the primary benefactor
funding the watch.

source:
手を引けってのは、そういうこ
と・・・
translation: So that's what 'back off' meant...

source:
私が死んでも金は動く。
だから、奴らは・・・アリス！
translation:
Even if I die, the money flows. That's why
they targeted Alice!

source:
大変です！アリスちゃんがまた
さらわれちゃったんですぅ！
translation:
Terrible news! Lady Alice has been kidnapped
again!

source: 見たのか！？

はいです！夜のお散歩してたら
大きなコーモリさんが飛んでて、
translation:
Yes! While on my evening stroll, a huge bat
flew past,

source:
よく見たら、小脇にアリスちゃ
んを・・・

source: それで、どっちへ！？

source:
海岸の、ボートハウスの方に降
りて行きましたです

source: 案内して！

source: はいです！

source:
マクドガルさん、アリスは必ず
助け出してきます
translation:
Mister MacDougal, we swear we'll bring
Alice back safe and sound.

source: 頼む・・・君たちだけが頼りだ
translation: Please... You are my only hope!

source: Ｔ．Ｔ．おじさんが！？

おじさんはやめろって。まだま
だ現役だってところを見せてや
るよ。ガストン、あとを頼む
translation:
Quit calling me Mister! I'll prove I've
still got it. Gaston, hold the fort.

source: へ、へい・・・
translation: Y-Yes, Master...

source: あそこか・・・

source: どうすんだ？
translation: What's the plan?

source:
アリスがいるから、うかつに手
が出せないわね
translation: Alice is hostage, so we can't rush in blindly.

source: とにかく、中に入ってみよう
translation: Let's sneak inside first.

source: アリスちゃん！？

source:
ここ、これはこれは・・ギルド
マスターじじ直々の、お越し・・
translation:
W-Well, well... If it isn't the Guildmaster
him-himself...

source:
人違いだ。俺は善良な一般ナイ
スガイだ
translation:
Mistaken identity. I'm merely a handsome,
law-abiding gentleman.

source: そ、そうか・・・じゃ、消えな
translation: I-Is that so? Then get lost.

source: どわわわわわっ！？
translation: Whoaaaaa?!

source:
ほほ他のザコどもは、ここで、
死ね・・わかってると、思う、
が・・お俺に手を、出す・・
translation:
The rest of you worms die here... Cross me,
and you know what happens...

source: ここ、こいつ・・死ぬ
translation: Th-This girl... dies!

source:
や、やるな・・にに人間の、く
せに・・
translation: N-Not bad... for puny humans...

source: アリスを放しなさい！
translation: Let Alice go!

source:
いいの、か？・・オレに、そん
な口、を、きいて・・
translation: You sure about that? Talking back to me...

source:
ひ、人質の、ことを、忘れてる
・・じゃないの、か？
translation: F-Forgot who has the hostage... did you?

source: ・・・どうすればいいのよ
translation: ...What do you want, then?

source:
ぶぶ武器、と・・・アイテム
を、そこの・・穴に、捨て、ろ
・・
translation:
T-Throw your weapons and items down that
hole... all of them!

source: 何だとぉ！？
translation: What did you say?!

source:
ゲッゲッ、嫌か？・・こいつ、
殺すぞ？
translation:
Kehehe! Hesitating? Want me to slit her
throat right now?

source: クッ・・・
translation: Grrr...

source: さ、さて・・どうするかな・・・
translation: N-Now then... what shall I do with you...?

source: うおっ！？
translation: Whoa?!

source: みんな！逃げて！
translation: Everyone! Run!!

source: ぎゃあああああっ！
translation: KYAAAAHH!

source: アリスちゃん！？
translation: Alice?!

source: ゲ・・・また、来る・・・
translation: Gah... We'll meet again...
Ugh...

source: ひでぇ・・！
translation: Horrible...!

source: 早く手当てを！
translation: Treat her wounds immediately!

source:
でも、回復魔法が使えるのはア
リスだけです・・薬も捨てられ
ちゃったし・・
translation:
But Alice is our only healer, and our medicines
were thrown down the shaft!

source:
じゃあ、急いで雑貨屋へ薬を買
いに行けば・・・
translation: Then someone run to the shop for remedies...!

source:
駄目だ・・・この深手じゃ、
戻って来るまでもたねぇ
translation:
No good... With wounds this deep, she won't
last until anyone gets back!

source: そんな・・・
translation: No...

source:
・・・ごめんなさい・・・やっ
ぱり・・私・・・足手まとい・
・だった・・・
translation:
...I'm sorry... In the end... I was just
a burden to you all...

source: アリスちゃん！？しっかり！
translation: Alice?! Hold on! Stay with us!

source:
ラディッシュの・・歌・・・聞
きたかっ・・た・・・
translation: I wanted to hear... Radish sing... just once...

source: アリスちゃん！！
translation: ALICE!!

source: そんな・・・
translation: This can't be happening...

source: すー・・・
translation: Haaah...
Her wounds are...?!

source: エイド・・・歌唱魔法！？
translation: Aid... Singing magic?!

source: ラディッシュさん・・・
translation: Radish...

source:
いやあ、それにしても、無事で
よかったよかった
translation:
Well now, what a relief everyone made it
back in one piece!

source:
（アリスが危なかったことは言
わなくていいの？）
translation:
(Shouldn't we mention how close Alice was
to dying?)

source:
（言ったら、マクドガルさん
ショック死するわよ）
translation:
(If we tell him, Mister MacDougal will drop
dead of cardiac arrest.)

source:
しっかし、おっさん、
ギルドマスターのくせに役に立
たねぇなぁ
translation:
Still, pops, you were totally useless for a
supposed Guildmaster.

source: 面目ない・・・
translation: I have no excuse...

source:
まあまあ、ボクらの装備を全部
拾い上げてくれたんだから
translation:
Come on, at least he fished all our gear
out of that pit!

source:
しかし、まずいことになったな。
奴らがこうも直接的な攻撃に出
るとは・・・
translation:
Troubling times ahead. I never anticipated
they would strike so directly...

source: 私・・屋敷に連れ戻されるの？
translation: Am I... going to be forced back to the manor?

source:
いや・・・むしろ、このまま
パーティにいた方が安全だろう
な
translation:
No... on the contrary, staying with this party
is far safer.

source:
その通りだ。カリンさん、どう
かアリスをよろしくお願いします
translation:
Quite so. Karin, please continue looking
after Alice.

source: でも・・・
translation: But...

source: アリスを守る必要はありません。
translation: You have no obligation to shield her.

source:
むしろ、あの子がいることであ
なたがたに迷惑をかけることに
なるでしょう。
translation:
Indeed, her presence will bring great danger
to you all.

source:
それを承知の上でお願いしてい
ます
translation: Yet I beg this favor knowing that full well.

source:
カリンちゃん。俺からも頼む。
この街は、ある意味すでに戦
争状態とも言える。
translation:
Karin, I ask you as well. In a sense, this
town is already plunged into open war.

source:
もし、俺たちが負けたら、奴ら
はすぐにでもこの街を襲うだろ
う
translation:
If we fall, they will burn this town to
the ground.

source: カリン・・・
translation: Karin...

source: 冗談じゃないわね
translation: Are you kidding me?

source: カリン！？
translation: Karin?!

ウェイトレス姿もいいが、水着
も素敵だ
translation:
Waitress outfits are great, but her swimsuit
is truly magnificent.

source: うむ
translation: Indeed.

source:
チャンピオン！それじゃあ、ど
んどん行ってみよう！
translation: Champion! Moving swiftly right along!

source:
２番手は、南国からやってきた
小麦色の黒髪！サニちゃんだぁ！
translation:
Number 2: the sun-kissed, dark-haired
beauty from the southern isles, Sanny!!

source: では、何か一言
translation: Say a few words, Sanny!

source:
みんな！あたいに投票してくれ
よな！
translation: Hey everyone! Vote for me, alright?!

source:
ストレートなコメントありが
とう！
translation: A direct appeal! Thank you!

source: これでは審査員！
translation: And the judges say?!

source: 健康的な女の子はいいねぇ
translation: A healthy, athletic girl is always a treat.

source: うむ
translation: Indeed.

source:
チャンピオン！次、行ってみよ
う！
translation: Champion! Next up!

source:
３番手は、雑貨屋のマドンナ、
サーラ姉ちゃんだ！
translation:
Contestant Number 3: the madonna of the
general store, Sarah!!

source:
あのー・・・お名前、これでい
いんですか？
translation: Um... are you certain about that stage name?

source: いいのよっ！
translation: Just go with it!

source:
３番手、雑貨屋のマドンナ、
サーラ姉ちゃんだ！
translation: Number 3, the store madonna, big sister Sarah!

source:
あのー、ホントのお名前は何と
おっしゃるのです？
translation: So what's your real name, actually?

source:
いーじゃない、美しければそん
なこと
translation: Who cares about names when you look this gorgeous?!

source: 確かに！では、何か一言
translation: Fair enough! Give us a word!

source:
あたしに投票しないと、ハーブ
を値上げするわよん
translation: Vote for me or I'm doubling herb prices!

source:
ダーっ！こいつぁ投票しないと、
この街の観光収入が大変なこと
になるぞ！
translation:
Yikes! We'd better vote for her or the town
economy collapses!

source: オッケー！審査員！
translation: Okay! Judges?!

source: ハーブもいいが、君が欲しい
translation: Herbs are fine, but it's you I want.

source: う〜む
translation: Hmm...

source:
チャンピオン！よし、次行って
みよう！
translation: Champion! Alright, moving on!

source:
４番手っ！温室育ちの汚れなき
一輪の花、アリスちゃんだぁ！
translation:
Number 4: a pure lily raised in a greenhouse,
Lady Alice!!

source:
期待しているよ！だけど、何か
一言・・・
translation: Great expectations! Say a few words!

source:
わっ！初めまして、サラさん。
年柄もなくときめいちゃったよ
translation:
Whoa! Pardon me, miss, but my heart is
fluttering like a schoolboy's!

source: どうかな？審査員！
translation: What say the judges?!

source: 少年の頃を思い出すね
translation: Reminds me of my innocent youth.

source: あうあうあう・・・
translation: Au-au-au...

source:
感動で声も出ないようだぜ！
オッケー！
translation: Speechless with emotion! Splendid!

source:
まだまだ来るぜ！お次は、屋根
の上の女王、カトリーヌちゃん！
translation:
Next up: the reigning queen of the rooftops,
Catherine!!

source: 誰か、つまみ出せ
translation: Someone throw that cat out!

source:
オッケー！気を取り直していっ
てみよう！
translation: Alright! Let's get back on track!

source:
次は注目だ！その姿は、まさに
ビーチに舞い降りた天使！モデル・
ローラ、マイカ・ローラちゃんだぁ！！
translation:
Behold, an angel descending onto the beach!
Supermodel Micah Laura!!

source:
わーん、あたしは男じゃありま
せん！食べないでください〜！
translation: Waaah! I'm not a boy, don't eat me!

source:
誰か！さっさと捕まえて海に捨
ててこい！
translation: Someone grab it and fling it into the sea!

source:
さあ、お祭りもいよいよ大詰め
だ！
translation: Now then, we reach the grand finale!

source:
最後に登場するのは、エントリ
ーの優勝候補、カリンちゃん
だぁっ！！
translation:
Our final contestant and heavy favorite:
Lady Karin herself!!

source:
飛び入り登場ですねぇ？
今のはいったい何なんですか？
translation:
A surprise walk-on entry! What a stunning
entrance!

source: 燃えるいい女よ。ホホホホホ
translation: A flaming passionate woman! Ohohoho!

source: うーん、ベタ〜ベタけど
translation: Well, a bit cliché, but...

source: では、審査員！
translation: Judges, your verdict?!

source:
その姿で、世界中の男性のハー
トを虜にして欲しい
translation:
May your radiance captivate the hearts of men
across the world!

source: うむ
translation: Indeed.

source:
チャンピオン！一人は完全に燃
え尽きちまったようだぜ！
translation:
Champion! One judge has burned out into
pure white ash!

source:
オーケー！！それでは、審査員
に移るとしよう。みんな、今手元
に用紙は行ってるかい？
translation:
Alright! Let's proceed to the vote. Does
everyone have their ballot slips?

source:
そいつに、一番いいと思った出
場者の名前を書いてくれ
translation: Write down the name of your favorite contestant!

source:
それじゃあ、結果発表までシー
ユーアゲイン！！
translation: We'll see you again for the final results!

source:
さーて、どうやら投票の集計も
終わったようだ。それでは発表
するぜ！
translation:
Tallying is complete! Time to announce
this year's Miss Attracta!

source: 今年の、ミス・アトランタは！？
translation: And the winner is...?!

source: ふっ、何だ！？
translation: Wh-What's that?!

source: なっ、何なんですか？これ？
translation: Wh-What are those things?!

source:
馬鹿な！？まだそんな時期では
ないはずだ！？
translation: Impossible! It's nowhere near that season!

source:
アル君、至急君たちに依頼した
い。
translation: Al! We need your party's help immediately!

source:
我々がみんなを避難させる間、
ここで上陸を食い止めて欲しい
translation: Hold the shoreline while we evacuate the crowd!

source: わ、わかりました！
translation: Understood! We're on it!

source:
何だか、とんでもないことに
なっちゃったね
translation: Things escalated in a hurry!

source:
捕まえて、カニ鍋にしてやろー
ぜ！
translation: Let's crack 'em and throw 'em in a hot pot!

source: よしっ！お仕事完了！
translation: Alright! Job done!

source:
へっへっへっ・・・こいつ、す
ぐ食えねえな
translation: Heh, can't eat these right away though.

source: カニの産卵？
translation: Crab spawning season?

source:
そう、アトランタでは見慣れた
光景だ。
translation: Yes, a common sight around Attracta.

source:
夏が終わる頃、カニたちは一
斉に浜に上がって産卵する
translation:
Toward the end of summer, crabs swarm ashore
in droves to lay eggs.

source:
誰かが食ってるから、狂暴なこ
との上ない
translation:
Fiercely protective of their eggs, and wildly
aggressive.

source: でも、夏はこれからよ？
translation: But summer has only just begun!

source:
そうなんだ・・・そのままの頭
と何か関係があるのかも知れな
いな
translation:
Indeed... Some bizarre disruption must have
triggered them early.

source:
これはそうとコンテストの審査
結果はどうなったんだい？
translation: By the way, what happened to the pageant results?

source:
投票用紙が全部カニに食い散ら
されて、もはやボロボロさ
translation:
The crabs chewed up every single ballot slip
into confetti.

source: あらら・・・残念です
translation: Oh dear... What a shame!

source:
マーサさんとアルさんはどなた
に投票したんですか？
translation: Who did you vote for, Al? And you, Martha?

source: 秘密だ
translation: Classified.

source:
アルはもちろん、あたいに入れ
たんだよな？
translation: You voted for me, right Al?

source: え？えーと・・・
translation: Uh? W-Well...

source: あははは・・・忘れちゃった
translation: Ahahaha... I completely forgot!

source: 何だよそれぇ！？
translation: What kind of answer is that?!

source: ゴ・・・ゴメン
translation: S-Sorry...!

source:
すまねぇな・・・急に呼び出し
たりして
translation:
Forgive me... Calling you out here so
suddenly.

source:
まったくだ・・・・どうして、
もっと早く知らせてくれなかっ
たんだ？
translation:
Seriously, old friend... Why didn't you
send for me sooner?

source:
へへ・・まだ、そう簡単にくた
ばったりしねぇよ・・
translation:
Heh... I don't plan on kicking the bucket
that easily...

source:
と言いたいところだが、さすが
にもうダメかも知れねぇ
translation:
Or so I'd like to say, but I fear my time
has truly come.

source: 親方・・・
translation: Master blacksmith...

source:
そこで、昔からの知り合いのよ
しみで、あんたに頼みたいこと
があるんだ・・
translation:
So as an old friend, I have one final favor
to ask of you...

source:
なんだ？俺にできることなら何
でも協力するよ
translation:
Name it. If it's within my power, I will
do whatever it takes.

source:
あ、ありがてぇ・・・頼みって
のは、他でもねぇ、孫のジャン
のことだ。
translation:
Th-Thank you... It is about my grandson,
Jean.

source:
あいつは、死んだ娘に似て優し
い・・だが、それだけじゃあこ
の世の中、渡って行けねぇ
translation:
He took after his late mother—gentle and
kind... But kindness alone won't survive.

source:
俺が残してやれるのは、この鍛
冶屋しかねぇ。
translation:
All I have left to pass down to him is
this smithy.

source:
だから、あいつにはこの鍛冶屋
を継げるような逞しい男になっ
て欲しい
translation:
So I want him to grow into a strong,
capable man who can carry on this forge.

source:
・・頼む。あいつを、ジャンを
鍛えてやってくれ。
translation:
...Please. Train him. Forge Jean into
a true man.

source:
こんなことを頼めるのは、あん
たしかいねぇ・・・頼む・・・
translation:
You are the only person I can trust with this...
I beg of you...
.........(This is quite a pickle)

source:
よう、早いな。早速仕事が入っ
てるぜ
translation:
Yo! You're early. A quest just rolled in
for you!

source: ホント！？
translation: Really?!

source:
と、言うわけで、早速上へ行っ
てくれ。依頼人がお待ちだ
translation:
Head upstairs right away. The client is
waiting for you.

source: オッケー
translation: Got it!

source: よっ、来たね
translation: Ah, you're here.

source:
ガストンに、お仕事って聞いた
んだけど・・その人が依頼人？
translation:
Gaston said there was a quest... Is that
person the client?

source:
いや、依頼人は何と、この俺な
のさ
translation: No, the client is none other than myself!

source: Ｔ．Ｔ．おじさんが！？
translation: Mister T.T.?!

source:
順を追って話そう・・・今朝、
俺の古い知り合いである、鍛冶
屋の親方が亡くなった。
translation:
Allow me to explain... This morning, my old
friend the master blacksmith passed away.

source:
依頼は、その遺言に関すること
なんだ・・・
translation: My commission concerns his dying wish...

source:
・・・なるほど。でも、鍛える
と言っても、具体的にどうすれ
ば良いのか・・
translation:
...I see. But when you say train him,
what should we actually do?

source:
それなんだが、やはり一度一緒
に冒険に連れて行ってもらうの
が一番良いと思うんだ
translation:
For that, I believe taking him along on
one of your adventures is best.

source: 冒険に？
translation: On an adventure?

source:
うん。モンスターの一匹も倒せ
ば、自信もつくと思うんだ。自
分も、そうだったからね
translation:
Yes. Felling even a single beast builds
confidence. It worked for me back then!

source: それなら、お安いご用よ
translation: In that case, consider it done!

source:
と、言うわけだ。がんばってお
いで
translation: That's the spirit! Give it your all, kids.

source:
ジャン君・・・だっけ？よろしく
ね
translation: You're Jean, right? Nice to meet you!
S-Sc...

source: こ？
translation: Sc?

source:
怖いよ～～っお姉さん、
助けて～～！
translation: I'm scared! Big sis, save meee!!

source:
ジャン君・・モンスターより彼
女の方がもっと怖いぞ
translation:
Jean... she's scarier than any monster
you'll ever meet.

source: はっ、はい・・・
translation: Y-Yes sir...

source:
・・・と言うわけで、今回だけ
スポット参戦してくれるジャン
君よ
translation:
...So, this is Jean, who will be guesting
with our party for this quest!

source: あ・・・よろしくお願いします
translation: Ah... Please take good care of me.

source: よろしくな
translation: Welcome aboard, kid.

source: 新しいお仲間さんですね？
translation: A new friend with us!

source: よろしくですぅ
translation: Nice to meet you!

source: よろしく・・（かわいそうに・）
translation: Welcome... (The poor boy...)

source: ウフフ、がんばってね
translation: Ufufu, do your best!

source: がんばってねぇ！
translation: Go get 'em!

source:
みんないい？今回は、ボクたちは
基本的にジャン君のサポート
だからね
translation:
Listen up, everyone! Our main objective today
is supporting Jean!

source: わかってますよ
translation: Understood!

source: ジャン君。準備はいい？
translation: Jean, are you ready?

source:
ボ、ボク・・やっぱりコワいか
ら・・帰る・・
translation:
I-I... I'm too scared after all... I want
to go home...

source: 聞こえないっ！？
translation: I'm sorry, I couldn't hear that?!

source: は、はいっ！がんばりますっ！
translation: Y-Yes ma'am! I'll do my very best!

source:
やった！やりましたよ！カリン
さん！
translation: I did it! I actually took one down, Karin!

source:
すっごおい！ジャン君やるじゃ
ない！
translation: Incredible! Look at you go, Jean!

source:
ありがとうございます。これも、
カリンさんや皆さんのおかげで
す
translation:
Thank you! It was all thanks to you and
everyone backing me up!

source:
またまたやりましたよ！カリン
さん！
translation: Downed another one, Karin!

source: すごいすごい！
translation: Awesome! Keep it up!

source:
すごい・・・ボクって、もしか
して天才かも？
translation: Amazing... Could I secretly be a combat prodigy?

source: うーん・・・
translation: Uh-oh...

source:
さあっ、皆さん！ボクの後につ
いてきて下さい。ボクが皆さん
を守ります！
translation:
Come, everyone! Follow my lead! I shall
protect you all!

source: おいおい
translation: Oh brother...

source:
強いっ！
ああっ、ボクは何て強いんだ！
自分の才能が恐ろしいっ！！
translation:
So strong!
Ah, how can I be so ridiculously gifted?!
My own talent terrifies me!!

source:
一度見殺しにした方がいいか
な？
translation:
Should we let him get smacked around once
to humble him?

source:
ああ・・やっぱりボクには無理
だったんだ・・・
translation: Aaargh... I knew I was useless after all...

source: 世話の焼ける・・・
translation: What a handful...

source:
結局、みんなボクたちで倒し
ちゃったね・・・
translation:
In the end, we had to defeat everything
ourselves...

source:
すみません・・・お役に立てな
くて
translation: I'm so sorry... I was no help at all.

source:
でも・・これじゃ、依頼を果た
したことにならないし・・・
translation:
Still... this means we didn't fulfill the
quest parameters...

source:
心配しないで下さい。依頼料は、
ボクが代わりに支払いますから
translation:
Please don't worry. I will pay the quest
fee out of my own pocket.

source: ええっ！？でも、それじゃ・・
translation: Wait, what?! But that defeats the point...

source:
ボク、皆さんには本当に感謝し
ているんです。
translation: I truly am grateful to all of you.

source:
皆さんが戦っている姿を見てい
たら、何と言うか…
translation: Watching the courageous way you all fought...

source:
ボクもがんばらなきゃって気持
ちになってきて・・・
translation:
it sparked something inside me to stand tall
and try harder!

source: ジャン君・・・
translation: Jean...

source: ボク、やってみます。
translation: I'm going to give it everything I've got.

source:
お爺ちゃんがボクのために残し
てくれた鍛冶屋を、立派に継い
でみせます！
translation:
I will inherit the smithy Grandfather left me
and make him proud!

source: ハア、ハア、ハア・・・
translation: Haa, haa, haa...

source: 大丈夫？
translation: Are you holding up?

source: は、はい・・・
translation: Y-Yes...

source:
どう？ちょっとは自信がつい
た？
translation: How was that? Did you gain some confidence?

source:
ええ。ボクでも、やればできる
んだってことがわかりました。
translation:
Yes. I realized that even I can do it if
I put my mind to it.

source:
ボク、お爺ちゃんの鍛冶屋を継
いでみようと思います
translation: I'm going to take over Grandfather's forge.

source:
良かったね。それじゃ、帰ろう
か
translation: That's wonderful! Let's head home, then.

source:
あっ・・・ボク、カリンさんた
ちに何かお礼をしたいんですけ
ど
translation:
Ah... I really want to give you all a token
of my gratitude.

source:
気にしなくていいわよ。報酬は
ちゃんとギルドからもらえるん
だから
translation:
Don't worry about it. The Guild pays our
bounty anyway.

source:
でも、ボクのためにしてもらっ
たことなんですから、
translation:
Still, you went through all this trouble
just for me,

source:
ボク自身がお礼をしなきゃいけ
ないんです。だから、これを・
・・
translation:
so I must present something from my own
hands. Please take this!

source:
いいの？
こんなものもらっちゃって
translation:
Are you sure? It feels wrong taking
something so nice.

source:
これ、僕が小さい頃にお爺ちゃ
んからもらったものなんです。
translation: Grandfather gave me this when I was a boy.

source:
たぶん、ボクが持ってても役に
立たないと思いますから
translation:
It will do much more good in your hands
than collecting dust with me.

source:
じゃあ、ありがたくもらってお
くね
translation: Then we accept with gratitude!

source:
カリンさん！ボク、今度のこと
で完全に自信がつきました！
translation:
Karin! This adventure gave me total confidence
in myself!

source: 良かったね
translation: Glad to hear it!

source:
これ、つまんないものですけど
ボクの感謝の気持ちです。受け
取って下さい！
translation:
It isn't much, but please accept this as
a token of my thanks!

source:
いいの？
こんなものもらっちゃって
translation: Are you sure about this?

source:
これ、僕が小さい頃にお爺ちゃ
んからもらったものなんです。
translation: Grandfather handed this down to me years ago.

source:
たぶん、ボクが持ってても役に
立たないと思いますから
translation: I wouldn't know how to wield it properly anyway.

source:
じゃあ、ありがたくもらってお
くね
translation: Thank you, Jean!

source:
ゴメン・・・手が一杯で、これ
以上持てないみたい
translation: Sorry... our inventory is full right now!

source: そ、そうですか・・・残念です
translation: I-I see... What a shame.

source: ・・・と言うわけ
translation: ...And that's the story.

source: そ、そうか。ご苦労だったな
translation: I see, I see. Fine work, everyone.

source:
ボク、やります！お爺ちゃんの
鍛冶屋を、このアトラクタで一
番の名所にしてみせます！
translation:
I will make Grandfather's smithy the most
famous landmark in all of Attracta!

source: う、うむ。良い心がけだ
translation: Y-Yes, a commendable spirit!

source:
何よ、さっきから聞いていれば
歯切れの悪い。何かあったの？
translation:
What's with the gloomy faces? Did something
happen?

source:
・・実は、さっき知らせが入っ
てね。
translation: ...Truth is, word just reached us.

source:
この前、魔獣騒ぎがあった鉱山
なんだが・・予想以上に傷跡が
深いらしい
translation:
The mine we cleared of monsters earlier...
The tunnel damage is far worse than expected.

source: それいで？
translation: And?

source:
少なくとも、半年は採掘を再開
できないらしい。
translation:
Mining operations cannot resume for at least
six months.

source:
つまり、その間は鍛冶屋も運営
できないって事だ
translation:
Which means the smithy has no iron to forge
anything.

source: すまん・・・力になれなくて
translation: I'm sorry, Jean... I wish I could do more.

source:
いいんです。皆さん、こんなボ
クのために一生懸命してくれた
んだし・・
translation:
It's alright. Everyone did so much for
someone like me...

source: 寂しいけれど・・仕方ないです
translation:
It's heartbreaking, but there's nothing
we can do.

source: しかし・・・
translation: Jean...

source:
この鍛冶屋も、ボクの代で終わ
りです。
translation: The smithy ends with my generation.

source:
せめて、ここを鍛冶屋以外の何
かに使えれば良かったですね・
・・
translation:
If only there were another use for the
building besides a forge...

source: ふーん・・・なるほどね
translation: Hmm... I see, I see.

source: 知恵、貸してあげよっか？
translation: Care to hear an idea of mine?

source: 暑い・・・
translation: So hot...

source: これ、サウナ・・って言うんですか？
translation: Is this what they call a 'sauna'?

source:
ええ。西の方の国で入ったこと
